title: net.rollback_window
description: M8B § Acceptance '6-frame rollback resimulates inside budget'. Emitted once per rollback resimulation window; payload carries the (from_tick, to_tick, resim_us, cause) so the replay viewer + observe.net.rollback_stats consumers can render perf timelines. NOT cosmetic.

resim_us.description: Total resimulation wall-clock cost in microseconds. Budget = 8000 (8 ms) at p99 per M8B § locked.

rollback_to_tick_elapsed_us.description: Sub-budget for the initial state-rollback (per spec 'rolls back to tick T within 1 ms').

per_frame_resim_elapsed_us.description: Sub-budget for the per-frame resimulation steps (≤ 7 ms p99 for 6 frames).
